points.point: The competitive comparison pages are sales positioning, not binding technical specifications.
points.label: partial
points.why: says battle cards/positioning are not specs, but not the competitive comparison pages specifically

points.point: The comparison page cannot replace the formal specifications / features documents of the R&S testers being compared.
points.label: covered
points.why: requires R&S claims be grounded in formal specs/features/configuration sources, not positioning

points.point: Competitor claims come from a single R&S internal battle card, so customer-facing use requires the competitor's official data plus third-party evidence.
points.label: covered
points.why: states internal battle-card competitor claims need competitor official data plus third-party evidence

points.point: Superlatives such as "only platform", "first validated", "leadership", "lower TCO", "fewer boxes" are sales language and must not be used as verifiable technical specifications.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not address superlatives, leadership, TCO, fewer boxes, etc.

points.point: Battle card numbers conflicting with the formal CMX500 specs may only be cited as a dated (2026-02-26) sales claim, not as binding specifications.
points.label: partial
points.why: says battle cards are not binding specs, but omits date, conflicting numbers, and no back-filling into CMX500 specs

points.point: The non-signaling / production path platforms (CMP180, CMP200, CMW100 K06) must each be cited from their own official source pages.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions CMP180 evidence only; omits CMP200 and CMW100 K06 and own official source-page requirement

points.point: Validated NTN / conformance leadership claims lack a validation report, test case list and PTCRB RFT version, which are the evidence still required.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention validation report, test case list, or PTCRB RFT version/date

points.point: A competitor's own official brochure can be used to describe that competitor's product but not to validate R&S advantage claims.
points.label: partial
points.why: requires competitor official evidence but does not state brochure cannot validate R&S advantage claims
